column3: The stock DECLARE_CLASS named NCWnd as the super while the C++ base is NCNPCHtmlViewer (the stock Super:: is NCWnd); our header keeps the C++ base. The generated IMPLEMENT_CLASS takes the super from analysis/classes.json (docs/notas/Standalone.md, section 3).
The stock DECLARE_CLASS named NCWnd as the super while the C++ base is NCItemWnd; same case as NCTestHtmlViewer.
The stock NCCmdTarget vtable has 37 slots; ours declares 24 and NCWnd declares slots 24..36 (src/nwindow/NCWnd.cpp). NW_CHECK_VTABLE compares the 24 that exist.

Our NCCmdTarget declares 24 virtuals, the stock 37 (slots 24..36 are declared in NCWnd here). NCCmdTarget is abstract and only NCWnd derives from it: its vtable is live only inside NCCmdTarget's constructor and destructor, which call no slot above 23.
